stories.title: Car burglary suspect on the run after shooting at officers, says Dallas Police
stories.summary: The Dallas Police Department said a suspect is on the run after shooting at officers during a foot chase after a suspected car burglary. Police said around 3:30 a.m. on Saturday officers responded to the 2600 block of John West Road to a burglary call at an apartment complex in E
